item.cobbleeffort_fusion.dna_splicers.to: Fuse two party Pokémon (head, then body), or unfuse a fusion. Used up by fusing.
Like DNA Splicers, but the fusion takes the higher of the two levels.
item.cobbleeffort_fusion.infinite_splice: DNA Splicers that are never used up.
item.cobbleeffort_fusion.dna_reversers.t: Swap a fusion's head and body. Used up.
cobbleeffort_fusion.pick.head: Choose the HEAD (or a fusion to unfuse)
cobbleeffort_fusion.unfused: The fusion came apart: both Pokémon are back.
cobbleeffort_fusion.unfused_pc: Your party is full: %s went to your PC.
cobbleeffort_fusion.design_credit: Colours from the Pokémon Infinite Fusion sprite by %s (via the Infinite Dex).
cobbleeffort_fusion.error.same: A Pokémon can't be fused with itself.
cobbleeffort_fusion.error.already: A fusion can't be fused again: unfuse it first.
cobbleeffort_fusion.error.party: Both Pokémon must be in your party.
cobbleeffort_fusion.error.no_head: This fusion's head couldn't be found.
cobbleeffort_fusion.error.battle: You can't splice DNA during a battle.
